title: CPI Announces Nationwide Jail Bharo Andolan Starting December 1
seoTitle: Delhi CPI announces nationwide Jail Bharo

tea.why: Protesters object to rising prices, unemployment, alleged attacks on democratic institutions, and government policies affecting workers and farmers.
tea.want: Demands include CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, halting electoral roll revision, ballot paper restoration, and legal MSP guarantees.
tea.changed: Nov 26: CPI leaders announced a three-day nationwide Jail Bharo Andolan from December 1 to 3 during a press conference in Delhi.

summary: The Communist Party of India (CPI) has announced a three-day nationwide 'Jail Bharo Andolan' scheduled from December 1 to 3, 2026. General Secretary D. Raja made the announcement during a press conference at the party headquarters in New Delhi, stating that at least five lakh party activists plan to court arrest across the country. The campaign focuses on several political and economic demands, including the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, an immediate halt to the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, the restoration of ballot papers, price control, employment generation, measures to strengthen public education and healthcare, implementation of women’s reservation, a legal guarantee for Minimum Support Price, and the repeal of four labour codes. No official government response to the announced agitation is noted in the sources.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Halt special intensive revision of electoral rolls and restore ballot papers
Legal guarantee for Minimum Support Price (MSP)
Control rising prices and generate employment
Repeal the four labour codes and implement women's reservation
response: No official response reported in the sources.
